'''Caring for a Mystery!''' (Japanese: '''とどけ波導！サトシと不思議なタマゴ！！''' ''Convey the {{tt|Wave Guidance|Aura}}! {{tt|Satoshi|Ash}} and the Mysterious Egg!!'') is the eighth chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the [[JN021|animated series episode by the same name]].

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{Ash}} is revealed to have {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{AP|Dragonite}} and a {{AP|Gengar}}.
* Ash receives a [[Pokémon Egg]] from [[Nurse Joy]] that hatches into a {{AP|Riolu}}.

===Debuts===
====Pokémon debuts====
* {{p|Dragonite}} ({{OP|Ash|Dragonite}})
* {{p|Gengar}} ({{OP|Ash|Gengar}})
* {{p|Riolu}} ({{OP|Ash|Riolu}})

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
* As the events of ''[[JN010|A Test in Paradise!]]'' and ''[[JN016|A Chilling Curse!]]'' were skipped, [[Ash's Dragonite]] and {{AP|Gengar}} debut here.
* As Ash only registers for the [[World Coronation Series]] in the [[JNM09|next chapter]], the battle against [[Hayden]] is just a normal battle between the two Trainers.
* [[Goh]] is never shown {{pkmn2|caught|catching}} an {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Exeggcute}}.
* Ash catches {{AP|Riolu}} immediately after driving the {{p|Onix}} off instead of taking it to a [[Pokémon Center]] first.
